problem: A single GitHub Actions hosted cron produced fewer than six intended capture runs on several complete UTC days; two cron lines in the same service cannot guarantee reliable coverage. Run creation time must not be equated with the source candle publication timestamp.
scope: Read-only, bounded, fully observed historical UTC days and source-archive measurements. No new market query, execution, paid RPC or real capital.
precommitment: This is a retrospective engineering diagnostic registered before implementing a general offline auditing program; it is NOT preregistration of a new strategy or of an untouched OOS interval.

inputs.github: Single complete GitHub REST GET /repos/DashSaman/Arz/actions/runs?event=schedule&branch=main&per_page=100 (or all pages in later runs). Preserve normalized metadata, URL and complete total_count.
inputs.market: Original immutable reports/strat01/forward/*.json independently validated by existing audit_capture_dir.

checks: Reject incomplete paginated run metadata; cannot infer missed runs from truncated lists
Filter exact workflow path, schedule event and main branch only
Reject duplicate IDs, malformed UTC timestamps, non-successful run as source success
Count run creation by complete UTC date without assigning ambiguous nominal cron occurrences
Count independently recorded timely paired-market bar closes by UTC close date, preserving late/missing rows
No source publication time, successful follower quote, paid execution or profit claims
Include negative controls: truncated response, wrong workflow, duplicate run, days with zero runs, late-only evidence, incomplete current day, invalid source
expected: For Oct 28-30 (if same six daily cron events configured), compare expected six daily nominal opportunities with verified GitHub schedule run records; sources are distinct from scheduler metadata.
acceptance: Offline tests plus actual GitHub Actions CI and audit reports; never auto-promote PAPER_READY, do not invent 194 bars.
